author: TEDx Talks
description:
Measuring nursing educational quality by NCLEX-RN first-time pass rates is not supported by evidence. Opinion leads to inconsistent licensure standards across states, which limits nursing school candidates and contributes to the nursing shortage.  

Blake Halladay, RN, is a proactive nurse leader committed to updating healthcare regulations to address clinician burnout and shortages. Halladay advocates for modern regulations that align with current practices, emphasizing reforms to enable healthcare professionals to maximize their expertise for improved patient care. 

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: We need more nurses. Here's how to train them. | Blake Halladay | TEDxNightingale College
